a2-03-01.title: Communicative Challenge: At the Pier
a2-03-01.scenario: The group is at the pier in Tam Cốc. Meg asks what you have done today. This morning you arrived at the pier and you saw the caves.
a2-03-01.prompt: Tell Meg that this morning you have arrived at the pier and that you have seen the caves.
a2-03-01.target: Esta mañana hemos llegado al embarcadero y hemos visto las cuevas.
a2-03-01.english: This morning we have arrived at the pier and we have seen the caves.
a2-03-01.canDo: I can say what I have done today, this morning or this afternoon using the pretérito perfecto.

a2-03-02.title: Communicative Challenge: This Week, This Year
a2-03-02.scenario: In the boat, Daniela asks about your trip. This week you have crossed the river, and this year you have travelled a lot.
a2-03-02.prompt: Tell Daniela what you have done this week and what you have done this year.
cues: Say what you have crossed this week
Say what you have done this year
a2-03-02.target: Esta semana hemos atravesado el río. Este año he viajado mucho.
a2-03-02.english: This week we have crossed the river. This year I have travelled a lot.
a2-03-02.canDo: I can say what I have done this week, this weekend, this month or this year.

a2-03-03.title: Communicative Challenge: So Far and Lately
a2-03-03.scenario: At the market near the river, Kaylee asks how the trip is going. So far you have seen three caves, and you have not tried the fruit yet.
a2-03-03.prompt: Tell Kaylee what you have seen so far and what you have not tried yet.
cues: Say what you have seen so far
Say what you have not tried yet
a2-03-03.target: Hasta ahora hemos visto tres cuevas. Todavía no hemos probado la fruta.
a2-03-03.english: So far we have seen three caves. We have not tried the fruit yet.
a2-03-03.canDo: I can say what I have done so far and lately, and what I have already done or not done yet.

a2-03-04.title: Communicative Challenge: On the Terrace
a2-03-04.scenario: On the terrace, Lauren asks about the day. You have visited the market this morning and you have rested on the terrace this afternoon.
a2-03-04.prompt: Tell Lauren that you have visited the market this morning, with the time word at the end, and that you have rested on the terrace this afternoon, with the time word at the start.
cues: Say where you went, then when
Say when, then where you have rested
a2-03-04.target: Hemos visitado el mercado esta mañana. Esta tarde hemos descansado en la terraza.
a2-03-04.english: We have visited the market this morning. This afternoon we have rested on the terrace.
a2-03-04.canDo: I can put a time word at the start or at the end of a sentence with the pretérito perfecto.

a2-03-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Boat Trip
a2-03-05.scenario: Back at the hotel, Lauren asks about the boat trip. So far you have seen very beautiful places, and you have not tried typical food yet.
a2-03-05.prompt: Tell Lauren what you have seen so far and what you have not tried yet.
cues: Say what you have seen so far
Say what you have not tried yet
a2-03-05.target: Hasta ahora hemos visto lugares muy bonitos. Todavía no hemos probado la comida típica.
a2-03-05.english: So far we have seen very beautiful places. We have not tried the typical food yet.
a2-03-05.canDo: I can tell the story of a boat trip using the pretérito perfecto with the right time words.

a2-03-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Outing
a2-03-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the outing in Tam Cốc, Meg asks about the day. Today you have rowed on the river, and you have not tried the typical food yet.
a2-03-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what you have done today and what you have not tried yet.
cues: Say what you have done today
Say what you have not tried yet
a2-03-consolidation.target: Hoy hemos remado en el río. Todavía no hemos probado la comida típica.
a2-03-consolidation.english: Today we have rowed on the river. We have not tried the typical food yet.
a2-03-consolidation.canDo: I can use the right time word with the pretérito perfecto to talk about a day out.
